root_clause_count_bound.statement: For every legitimate nonempty canonical root with frozen input size N, r0 live variables, m0 clauses and L0 literal occurrences, m0 <= N-2*r0-1.
proof: Full coverage of r0 distinct root variables requires L0>=r0.

small_clause_elimination_invariant.statement: If a unit-free ordinary CNF has at most m<=4 clauses, exact elimination of any pivot produces at most m distinct raw clauses and therefore at most m canonical output clauses.
proof: Let p and q be the positive/negative pivot-clause counts and let r=m-p-q be retained clauses.
At most p*q distinct non-tautological resolvents can be generated; duplicate suppression can only reduce this number.
Hence raw clause count <= r+p*q = m-p-q+p*q.
For all nonnegative integers p,q with p+q<=m<=4, m-p-q+p*q<=m. The sole largest balanced case m=4,p=q=2 gives equality 4.
canon_cnf and unit propagation/restriction cannot increase clause count.

raw_size_corollary.statement: On a continuing trajectory with at most m<=4 clauses and n live variables before elimination, every charged raw clause after eliminating a pivot has width at most n-1, so RAW_UNITS<=1+m*n.
raw_size_corollary.proof: There are at most m raw distinct clauses; each contributes at most one clause unit plus n-1 literal units, and there is one global state unit.

theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N25
theorem.statement: The N<=24 range is inherited from the audited T/Smax/Uraw theorem. At N=25 the only root-variable cases not certified by that combined envelope are r0 in {10,11}; the legitimate-root encoding forces at most 4 and 2 root clauses respectively, and the <=4-clause invariant keeps every later ordinary elimination far below cap 625. Therefore v2/v3 cannot be required because ordinary exact elimination lacks raw-cap availability for any legitimate root with N<=25.

N26_frontier.interpretation: N26 is not a failure layer. Only r0=9 and r0=10 remain outside the current sufficient cap proofs after combining the previous envelope with the sparse-root invariant.

next_exact_target: At N26 analyze r0=9 with m0<=7 and r0=10 with m0<=5 using exact clause-count recurrence together with live-variable decrease, canonical Smax and Uraw bounds; retain frozen grammar until a reachable current-v3 gap is established.
